source_and_atlas_comparison.method: Reproduced all features from pinned ODbL source for the exact 34 scoped shapeIDs; joined exact IDs to all 36 current-main world-index part files at the baseline commit; compared stable JSON SHA-256 of source geometry to Atlas stored geometry.
source_and_atlas_comparison.result: All 34 join exactly, with no duplicate baseline IDs; none of 34 geometry hashes are equal because Atlas stores a generalized/rounded geometry. Example: Polysaevo has 126 source coordinate positions and 10 Atlas positions; bounding boxes are close after rounding. This demonstrates Atlas simplification, not an error or a valid boundary match.
